pattern_id: Missing Parent-QC consistency validation allows Byzantine leaders to create malformed blocks
description: Missing validation that Block.Parent() == Block.QuorumCert().BlockHash() allows Byzantine leaders to create malformed blocks
trigger_condition: Byzantine leader creates block where Block.Parent points to early/fork block, but Block.QC points to latest valid block. This causes Parent chain to diverge from QC chain.
root_cause: NewBlock(parent, qc, ...) allows any combination of parent and QC. Voter.Verify() had no Parent-QC consistency check.
fix_approach: Add check in Voter.Verify(): if proposal.Block.Parent() != proposal.Block.QuorumCert().BlockHash() { return error }
